summary.text: PLA Wood is wood-filled polylactic acid. Makers sell it for objects with the look and feel of wood or cork. It is amorphous as printed, so it softens at its glass transition: its HDT at 0.45 MPa is 57 °C. On the H2C it prints at 200⁠–⁠220 °C, and a maker recommends an abrasion-resistant nozzle.
